title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Schedule of Notice Caps for Takeover-Card Liability
content:
**Schedule.** This schedule covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. On a dispute of a purchase on a *takeover card*, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created, the notice cap depends on the notice days. The notice days are the calendar days from the notice start date to the filing date.

| Notice days | Notice cap |
|---|---|
| no more than 2 | the card tier's liability cap for timely notice |
| more than 2 and no more than 10 | 50 percent of the card tier's liability cap for late notice, rounded to the cent (half up) |
| more than 10 | the card tier's liability cap for late notice |

The figure 2 is the number of days in the card tier's timely-notice period, which is 2 on every tier.

### The bands in amounts, by tier (USD)

| Card tier | Up to 2 notice days | 3 to 10 notice days | 11 notice days or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 0.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The first column is the liability cap for timely notice, which is 0.00 on every tier. The last column is the liability cap for late notice: 500.00 on Classic, Gold and Platinum, 50.00 on Signature, and 0.00 on Infinite and Infinite Metal. The middle column is 50 percent of the late-notice cap: 250.00, 25.00 and 0.00.

### Band edges

- 2 notice days is no more than 2, so it falls in the first band.
- 3 notice days is more than 2 and no more than 10, so it falls in the middle band.
- 10 notice days is still in the middle band, since "no more than 10" includes 10.
- 11 notice days is more than 10, so it falls in the last band.

*Hypothetical.* A Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit takeover card is disputed 7 notice days after the notice start date. The notice cap is 50 percent of 50.00, which is 25.00.
